title: Fair Chance Hiring Discussion
summary:
*   A press conference was held to discuss a proposed "fair chance hiring ordinance."
*   The ordinance aims to address employment barriers and create more opportunities for individuals in Austin.
*   A significant number of City Council members were expected to be present, highlighting broad interest in the policy.
*   This gathering was an informational session, with no official votes or policy decisions made at the event itself.
